title: Duplicate ooRexx class directive
purpose: Prevent ambiguous or unintended repeated class definitions.
trigger: More than one ::class directive declares the same class name in one source object.
correct: Keep one intended class definition or rename the distinct class.
compiler_relationship: Translator behaviour is not used as the rule definition; this is a structural source rule.
return_semantics: A LanguageRulePage may be opened and then return to the originating cycle selector.
